newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Middle east S.Lankans remit 46.5 bln rupees in '96.
newsitem.headline: Middle east S.Lankans remit 46.5 bln rupees in '96.

text.p: Sri Lankans working in Middle East countries brought in 46.5 billion rupees in foreign exchange earnings last year, a government minister said on Wednesday.
Minister of Labour, John Seneviratne, replying to a question in parliament, said that the earnings were 5.58 billion rupees higher than in the previous year.
The number of Sri Lankans employed in Middle Eastern countries had however declined from 172,467 in 1995 to 162,572 in 1996, the minister said.
Overseas Sri Lankan workers account for second highest foreign exchange earnings for the country after garment exports. ($1=58.8 rupees)
